Immediately after prepare_candidate_batch, call partition_candidate_batch exactly once with the unmodified artifact_id and the complete assigned-ID list. Compare all shortlisted candidates on primary operation, physical object, and scope/detail, favoring a specific operation-object match over generic lexical overlap; fused rank is only a tie-breaker. For each reviewed item select exactly three distinct supplied artifact-local candidate_index values in final rank order.

Before durable persistence, confirm internally that the authoritative partition is disjoint and covers all assigned IDs, every review ID has exactly one successful evidence result and a concrete three-distinct-index decision, and every fallback ID has concrete valid ranked predictions from the server-side fused top-three fallback. Then use exactly one durable path per ID: save_review_decisions only for all review_ids with their exact artifact-local indices, and save_candidate_predictions only for all fallback_ids. Never include a reviewed ID in fallback saving, never overlap IDs across durable calls, never retry a rejected or completed durable write, and never write an ID twice. Do not call stage_candidate_predictions, do not save fallback predictions for the full batch, and do not process any other IDs or finalize the run.

Return immediately with a compact completion report containing the artifact_id, counts/IDs of reviewed and fallback items, and confirmation that both complementary durable paths succeeded. args.request:
SAMPO historical-construction label-mapping batch — single bounded unit. Execute the complete workflow end-to-end on your side: exact prescribed multi-retriever retrieval, server-side deterministic partition by top-1 disagreement, selective semantic review of the disagreement partition, and non-overlapping durable prediction writes. Do not use any retriever set other than the prescribed one.

IDENTIFIERS / UNIT BOUNDARY
- run_id: NOT supplied in the coordinating context. Use the run_id already bound server-side to this batch/artifact index; if the harness exposes none, echo run_id=UNKNOWN in your return and do not substitute a fabricated id.
- batch offset: 0 (no offset value was supplied to me; treat this as one single bounded unit starting at offset 0).
- artifact_id (from the harness retrieval transcript provided as context): 1fba3180d16d0fd3a5d490719493b3f674cbe7322bea71870263094626724253
- assigned example IDs (the only IDs evidenced in the supplied harness context; 10 total):
  12540, 13851, 7937, 7872, 10783, 4488, 9154, 13515, 10495, 10581
- Interpretation named explicitly: if the harness defines the assigned ID set differently from the list above, the harness/run_id-bound set governs; report the discrepancy in your return rather than silently changing scope. Do not expand beyond the assigned unit.

MANDATORY RETRIEVAL CONSTRAINT
- Retrieval must be performed with exactly the prescribed five methods already evidenced in this batch's artifacts: bm25_token, char_tfidf, char_word_fusion, construction_token_tfidf, word_tfidf. Do not add, drop, or reweight retrievers.
- Retrieval is artifact-backed (candidate evidence returned per example with fused_candidates, fused_rank, fusion_score, support_count, best_rank, methods). Pre-existing retrieved evidence for artifact 1fba3180d16d0fd3a5d490719493b3f674cbe7322bea71870263094626724253 may be reused only if it is bound to the same run_id and the same assigned IDs; otherwise re-run the prescribed retrieval for the assigned unit only.

MANDATORY PARTITION + REVIEW CONSTRAINT
- Partition must be server-side and deterministic, keyed on top-1 disagreement across the retrievers: examples where all retrievers agree on top-1 go to the automatic/unanimous partition; examples with any top-1 disagreement go to the review partition.
- Semantic review applies only to the disagreement/review partition. Do not hand-review the unanimous partition, and do not skip review for any example in the disagreement partition.
- Every reviewed example must be mapped to a label drawn from the allowed label space only (labels observed in the candidate evidence / allowed label list). No free-form or invented labels; if no candidate is acceptable, record an explicit abstain/unresolved marker for that example instead of guessing.

MANDATORY PERSISTENCE CONSTRAINT
- Persist predictions durably to the run's prediction store, non-overlapping: one write per assigned example ID, no duplicate example IDs within the batch, no re-write of example IDs already written by another unit. Include example_id, chosen label, and the evidence/method provenance for each prediction.
- If a write would collide with an existing prediction for the same example_id outside this unit, stop and report the collision as an unresolved unit item instead of overwriting.

HARNESS CONTEXT
- This batch was previously retrieved against artifact 1fba3180d16d0fd3a5d490719493b3f674cbe7322bea71870263094626724253, giving 10 examples with 7–10 fused candidates each. Some top-1 sets are strongly split (e.g. 12540 top-1 Теплоизоляция внутренних стен мин. плитами vs Теплоизоляция оборудования / Теплоизоляция трубопроводов all at support_count 5; 9154 and 13515 and 7937/7872 show low fusion_score margins with mixed best_rank winners), so expect a substantial disagreement partition.
- I perform no retrieval and no persistence myself; you own the bounded unit.

RETURN (compact completion report)
- status: durable-completed | pre-persistence failure | unresolved unit
- run_id (or UNKNOWN), artifact_id, offset, assigned ID count, IDs processed
- partition sizes (unanimous vs disagreement)
- number of predictions durably written, plus collision/overlap check result
- any example IDs left unresolved and the reason
- any discrepancy between the assigned ID list above and the harness-bound set
